title: Port owned command registration, catalog and schema admission
scope: Complete registerCommands/listCommands/runsHeadless and start admission before scheduling, preserving partial registration failures, cleanup behavior, exact ordered metadata and coerced arguments. No command body, queue/history or fake public command.
acceptance: Independently executed complete pinned registry module compares full catalog/headless/error/admission state after each operation, including all140 original command definitions and fixed seeded inputs.
Source observations precede Rust; deliberate metadata/error/value changes fail; native/Wasm compile, bounded owned storage and explicit remaining session integration.
open_items: Live scheduler/history/settle/timeout/jobs, arbitrary shared definition mutation, locale/platform acceptance and public command execution remain separate session continuations.
